title: Conditions of Rental: Class, Renter, Pickup and Upgrades (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
These conditions govern, for every Rental Vehicle Coordination class, the renter, the party the class must carry, the card presented, the partner's pickup and delivery service, courtesy classes and moves up between classes. They apply when a rental is reserved, when its class is changed and when it is picked up.

## Conditions

1. The renter must be at least the class minimum renter age at pickup.
2. The clause under which the renter pays the class young-renter fee per rental day when not older than the class's highest young-renter age is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of Rental Vehicle Coordination.
3. The class must seat the party, in seats and in large suitcases.
4. The renter presents one of the class's accepted cards, on which the class card hold is held until settlement.
5. The partner needs the class's hours of notice; it offers Saturday pickup only where the class has Saturday pickup available, and delivers to the repair center only where the class has delivery to the repair center available.
6. A warranty courtesy rental uses only a class marked usable for a warranty courtesy rental.
7. A customer may move up from a class only where that class allows moving up, paying the difference per rental day on the class-difference basis (the daily rate difference) between the class rented and the class the payer covers.
8. A class change after pickup applies from the next rental day.

## The renter's age at pickup

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Applies to | Recording the pickup |
| Condition | The renter must be at least the class minimum renter age at pickup |
| Evidence | The renter's age as stated by the caller, recorded on the reservation being picked up |
| Authority | The caller's statement, taken before the pickup is recorded |

"At least" includes equality: a renter whose age equals the class minimum meets condition 1.

## Hypothetical cases

- A renter aged 23 picks up a Standard SUV Rental, whose minimum renter age is 23: condition 1 is met. A renter aged 22 does not meet it for that class.
- A renter on rent in a Compact Rental moves up to an Intermediate Rental after pickup, the payer covering the Compact class: the difference is the Intermediate daily rate less the Compact daily rate for each rental day, and it applies from the next rental day.
- A warranty courtesy rental is requested in the Full-Size Rental class, which is not marked usable for a warranty courtesy rental: condition 6 is not met.

superseded_clauses: pays young_renter_fee_daily_usd per rental day when not older than young_renter_max_age
